subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt all five proposed memory roles, including `memory.dreaming`, plus per-agent overrides as the durable public plugin/config contract now?
rationale: The canonical issue supports role-specific memory composition, but the separate general dreaming protocol remains open; code review cannot decide whether a permanent dreaming selector should ship before its complete lifecycle contract.

options.title: Land implemented roles first
options.body: Adopt recall, capture, compaction, and userModel now, and defer dreaming until its general plugin invocation protocol is defined.

options.title: Adopt all five roles
options.body: Accept dreaming as an ownership selector now and define its richer lifecycle protocol in the existing follow-up issue.

options.title: Wait for RFC outcome
options.body: Pause the public contract until the related RFC settles the complete role taxonomy and lifecycle semantics.

recommendation.title: Land implemented roles first
recommendation.body: Adopt recall, capture, compaction, and userModel now, and defer dreaming until its general plugin invocation protocol is defined.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available routing candidate across the current-main memory/plugin surfaces and was explicitly mentioned for this architectural proposal.
